title: Critical square-root bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $0<p_c<1$, $0\le p_0\le p_c$, and the biased-minus probability polynomial of $f$ at $p_c$ equals $1/2$. Then its value at $p_0$ is at most $\frac12\sqrt{p_0/p_c}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
